scripts.prototype:lifecycle: VITE_PROTOTYPE=true bun run build && wrangler dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json --port 8788
scripts.verify: tsc --noEmit && bun test && bun run build && bun run check:output && echo LAUNCH VERIFY OK
scripts.deploy:ingestion:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply vaporstats-d1 --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env="" && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.ingestion.jsonc --env=""
scripts.deploy:ingestion:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply vaporstats-staging-d1 --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.ingestion.jsonc --env staging
